title: Rootwarden

steps.prompt: A towering guardian golem made of twisted pale tree roots and grey stone slabs, four metres tall, broad shoulders, long heavy arms, small head with one soft gold glowing knot for a face, moss on its shoulders, calm not evil. A single creature alone, centred, whole body in frame with margin, neutral standing pose, three-quarter front view, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no scenery. Cel-shaded anime game art, flat colours with two-tone shading, clean dark ink outlines on characters and objects, bright saturated palette, blue-violet shadows instead of black, soft clear daylight, simple readable shapes, strong silhouette, hand-painted look, no photorealism, no film grain, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 40000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 2048 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 4.00 m, origin at the centre of the base.
notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/concepts/con_rootwarden.png. The concept image went through TRELLIS.2 (BiRefNet cut-out, shape, texture, remesh, reduce to about 40,000 triangles, unwrap, bake), then Blender reduced it to the budget and re-baked the texture.
